title: API Security & Production Hardening
hardening: Global Cloudflare Pages Functions middleware for method, CORS, rate limiting, request IDs and security headers
POST JSON payload limits: 256 KiB for /api/ai and 512 KiB for other API POSTs
Origin allowlist supports same-origin plus VANDIRA_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
Static _headers security baseline with CSP, HSTS and cross-origin protections
Public retrieval trace reduced to non-sensitive operational metadata by default; full trace only with explicit VANDIRA_DEBUG_TRACE=true
Legacy wildcard CORS declarations removed from API source files
notes: Rate limiting is an in-memory per-isolate guard; durable distributed rate limiting should use a configured Cloudflare KV/Durable Object in a later infrastructure step.
CSP remains compatible with the existing inline-script application; unsafe-inline is retained to avoid breaking the current UI and should be removed after nonce/hash migration.
